source: can you make me a slip and slide game were the longer you slide the more points you get and you can buy pets to help you speed multiplier and there a treadmills to train your speed and make it 1m studs is the end of the track then you go back to the start of the slip and slide and get 1 lap on your character that is on the top of the screen to show your progress and make furthest stud leader board,most money leader board and most playtime leader board with a popular thumbnail of a bacon sliding on a slip in slide covered in soap with rainbow text saying 999m studs

answers.ask: Is one million studs literal? At walk speed that is over seventeen hours of track - should it be a repeating segment instead?
answers.answer: Make it a repeating segmented track with progress measured up to 1,000,000 studs, so it stays playable while still showing the 1m-stud goal.

answers.ask: What does the slide sit in - a water park, a grass field, a neon void?
answers.answer: Set the slip and slide in a bright cartoon water park with grass around it, soap, and colorful rainbow visuals.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D slip-and-slide map in a bright cartoon water park, with a long repeating segmented slide track that represents progress up to 1,000,000 studs. The slide begins at a clear start area and runs through grassy park surroundings with soap-covered surfaces and colorful rainbow visuals, looping seamlessly so riders can return to the start after reaching the end goal. Include treadmill training areas near the start, and leave space for physical leaderboard displays for furthest distance, most money, and most playtime.
